headline: Violation hearings for Icy Gaming and Jolo, Inc. dba Hurricane Betty's, plus one-day liquor and entertainment requests and restaurant hours.
summary: The meeting will hold violation hearings for two businesses. It will also review one-day liquor and entertainment requests, restaurant operating hours, and other alcohol and entertainment requests.
items: Ashland Brewing, LLC, Worcester Holiday Market, 211 Commercial Street-Mercantile Building: one-day liquor license request for dates in November and December 2026
Festival of Lights, Worcester Common: one-day entertainment license request for live music, dancing by entertainers, amplification, Roving LED and fire performers on Friday, December 4, 2026
City of Worcester Festival of Lights: one-day liquor license request on Friday, December 4, 2026
Worcester Historical Museum dba Museum of Worcester: one-day liquor license and one-day entertainment license requests for live music and dancing on November 5, 6, and 7, 2026
Ciro's Pizza, 186 Stafford Street: common victualer request with listed operating hours
Dragon Dynasty, 104 Highland Street: common victualer request with listed operating hours
Worcester Detachment Marine Corps League, 181 Lake Avenue: request for change of manager
Eddy's Pub and Sports Bar, Inc., 120 Stafford Street: request for entertainment license for TV, radio, recorded music, live music, and karaoke
Violation hearing: Icy Gaming, 117 Lovell Street
Violation hearing: Jolo, Inc. dba Hurricane Betty's, 350 Southbridge: violations of Rule #1 (2 counts), Rule #14, #17, #29, and #3
location: Esther Howland Chambers, 3rd Floor, City Hall
